  c.width = width;
  c.height = height;
  return c;
}
export function cloneCanvas(c) {
  const out = canvas(c.width, c.height);
  out.getContext("2d").drawImage(c, 0, 0);
  return out;
}
export function hexRGB(hex) {
  return [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
}
export function replaceColorSegment(ctx, a, b, from, to, width = 1) {
  const size = Math.max(1, Math.round(width)), radius = Math.floor(size / 2);
  const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.min(a.x, b.x)) - radius),
    y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.min(a.y, b.y)) - radius),
    x1 = Math.min(ctx.canvas.width, Math.floor(Math.max(a.x, b.x)) - radius + size),
    y1 = Math.min(ctx.canvas.height, Math.floor(Math.max(a.y, b.y)) - radius + size);
  if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return;
  const image = ctx.getImageData(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0), rgb = hexRGB(from), replacement = hexRGB(to);
  let x = Math.floor(a.x), y = Math.floor(a.y);
  const bx = Math.floor(b.x), by = Math.floor(b.y), dx = Math.abs(bx - x), dy = -Math.abs(by - y), sx = x < bx ? 1 : -1, sy = y < by ? 1 : -1;
  let err = dx + dy;
  for (;;) {
    for (let py = Math.max(y0, y - radius); py < Math.min(y1, y - radius + size); py++)
      for (let px = Math.max(x0, x - radius); px < Math.min(x1, x - radius + size); px++) {
        const i = ((py - y0) * image.width + px - x0) * 4;
        if (image.data[i + 3] > 0 && rgb.every((v, k) => image.data[i + k] === v)) image.data.set(replacement, i);
      }
    if (x === bx && y === by) break;
    const e = 2 * err;
    if (e >= dy) { err += dy; x += sx; }
    if (e <= dx) { err += dx; y += sy; }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(image, x0, y0);
}
export function colorAt(c, x, y) {
  const d = c
    .getContext("2d")
    .getImageData(
      Math.min(c.width - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(x))),
      Math.min(c.height - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(y))),
      1,
      1,
    ).data;
  return (
    "#" +
    [...d.slice(0, 3)].map((v) => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")
  );
}
export function floodFill(c, x, y, color, tolerance = 0) {
  x = Math.floor(x);
  y = Math.floor(y);
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= c.width || y >= c.height) return false;
  const ctx = c.getContext("2d"),
    image = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height),
    d = image.data;
  const idx = (y * c.width + x) * 4,
    target = [...d.slice(idx, idx + 4)],
    replacement = [...hexRGB(color), 255];
  if (target.every((v, i) => v === replacement[i])) return false;
  const visited = new Uint8Array(c.width * c.height);
  const matches = (i) =>
    !visited[i / 4] &&
    Math.abs(d[i] - target[0]) <= tolerance &&
    Math.abs(d[i + 1] - target[1]) <= tolerance &&
    Math.abs(d[i + 2] - target[2]) <= tolerance &&
    Math.abs(d[i + 3] - target[3]) <= tolerance;
  // Scanline flood fill: no recursive stack overflow on large solid images.
  const stack = [x, y];
  while (stack.length) {
    const sy = stack.pop(),
      sx = stack.pop();
    let left = sx;
    while (left >= 0 && matches((sy * c.width + left) * 4)) left--;
    left++;
    let above = false,
      below = false;
    for (
      let xx = left;
      xx < c.width && matches((sy * c.width + xx) * 4);
      xx++
    ) {
      const i = (sy * c.width + xx) * 4;
      d.set(replacement, i);
      visited[i / 4] = 1;
      if (sy > 0) {
        const m = matches(i - c.width * 4);
        if (m && !above) stack.push(xx, sy - 1);
        above = m;
      }
      if (sy < c.height - 1) {
        const m = matches(i + c.width * 4);
        if (m && !below) stack.push(xx, sy + 1);
        below = m;
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  return true;
}
export function colorKey(source, hex) {
  const c = cloneCanvas(source),
    ctx = c.getContext("2d"),
    image = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height),
    [r, g, b] = hexRGB(hex);
  for (let i = 0; i < image.data.length; i += 4)
    if (
      image.data[i] === r &&
      image.data[i + 1] === g &&
      image.data[i + 2] === b
    )
      image.data[i + 3] = 0;
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  return c;
}
export function bmpBytes(c) {
  const w = c.width,
    h = c.height,
    stride = Math.ceil((w * 3) / 4) * 4,
    buf = new ArrayBuffer(54 + stride * h),
    v = new DataView(buf),
    d = c.getContext("2d").getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
  v.setUint16(0, 0x4d42, true);
  v.setUint32(2, buf.byteLength, true);
  v.setUint32(10, 54, true);
  v.setUint32(14, 40, true);
  v.setInt32(18, w, true);
  v.setInt32(22, h, true);
  v.setUint16(26, 1, true);
  v.setUint16(28, 24, true);
  v.setUint32(34, stride * h, true);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const s = ((h - 1 - y) * w + x) * 4,
        t = 54 + y * stride + x * 3,
        a = d[s + 3] / 255;
      v.setUint8(t, Math.round(d[s + 2] * a + 255 * (1 - a)));
      v.setUint8(t + 1, Math.round(d[s + 1] * a + 255 * (1 - a)));
      v.setUint8(t + 2, Math.round(d[s] * a + 255 * (1 - a)));
    }
  return new Uint8Array(buf);
}
export function paintSegment(ctx, a, b, opts) {
  const {
    width = 1,
    color = "#000000",
    type = "brush",
    brush = "round",
    background = "#ffffff",
  } = opts;
  ctx.save();
  if(type==='brush'){
    const start=stampBounds(a,width),end=stampBounds(b,width),left=Math.min(start.x,end.x),top=Math.min(start.y,end.y);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(left,top,Math.max(start.x,end.x)+start.width-left,Math.max(start.y,end.y)+start.height-top);ctx.clip();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = width;
  ctx.lineCap = type === "pencil" ? "butt" : "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  if (type === "eraser") {
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
    ctx.lineCap = "square";
  }
  if (type === "pencil" || type === "eraser") {
    pixelSegment(ctx, a, b, width, type === 'pencil');
  } else if (
    type === "brush" &&
    [
      "airbrush",
      "crayon",
      "oil",
      "watercolor",
      "calligraphy",
      "marker",
    ].includes(brush)
  ) {
    const distance = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y),
      n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(distance / Math.max(1, width / 6)));
    for (let step = 0; step <= n; step++) {
      const x = a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * step) / n,
        y = a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * step) / n;
      if (brush === "calligraphy") {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(
          x,
          y,
          width * 0.6,
          Math.max(1, width * 0.16),
          -Math.PI / 4,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2,
        );
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (brush === "marker") {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2;
        ctx.fillRect(x - width / 2, y - width / 2, width, width);
      } else if (brush === "watercolor") {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        const count = brush === "airbrush" ? width * 2 : width * 3;
        ctx.globalAlpha = brush === "oil" ? 0.7 : 0.4;
        for (let j = 0; j < count; j++) {
          const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
            r = (Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * width) / 2;
          ctx.fillRect(
            Math.floor(x + Math.cos(angle) * r),
            Math.floor(y + Math.sin(angle) * r),
            brush === "oil" ? 2 : 1,
            brush === "oil" ? 2 : 1,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Odd widths are centred on a pixel centre; even widths on a pixel edge.
    // Axis-aligned strokes then occupy exactly N solid pixels, without side bleed.
    const align = value => Math.floor(value) + (width % 2 ? 0.5 : 0);
    a = { x: align(a.x), y: align(a.y) };
    b = { x: align(b.x), y: align(b.y) };
    if (brush === "square" && type === "brush") ctx.lineCap = "square";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (a.x === b.x && a.y === b.y) {
      if (type === "eraser" || brush === "square")
        ctx.fillRect(a.x - width / 2, a.y - width / 2, width, width);
      else {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

const circleSpans = new Map();
export function stampBounds(point, width) {
  const size = Math.max(1, Math.round(width));
  return { x: Math.floor(point.x) - Math.floor(size / 2), y: Math.floor(point.y) - Math.floor(size / 2), width: size, height: size };
}
export function pixelSegment(ctx, a, b, width, round = false) {
  const size = Math.max(1, Math.round(width)), offset = Math.floor(size / 2);
  let spans = circleSpans.get(size);
  if (round && !spans) {
    const radius = (size - 1) / 2 + 0.25, centre = (size - 1) / 2;
    spans = Array.from({ length: size }, (_, y) => {
      let left = size, right = -1;
      for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) if ((x - centre) ** 2 + (y - centre) ** 2 <= radius ** 2) { left = Math.min(left, x);right = Math.max(right, x); }
      return { left, length: Math.max(0, right - left + 1) };
    });
    circleSpans.set(size, spans);
  }
  let x = Math.floor(a.x), y = Math.floor(a.y);
  const bx = Math.floor(b.x), by = Math.floor(b.y), dx = Math.abs(bx - x), dy = -Math.abs(by - y), sx = x < bx ? 1 : -1, sy = y < by ? 1 : -1;
  let err = dx + dy;
  for (;;) {
    if (round) spans.forEach((span, row) => { if (span.length) ctx.fillRect(x - offset + span.left, y - offset + row, span.length, 1); });
    else ctx.fillRect(x - offset, y - offset, size, size);
    if (x === bx && y === by) break;
    const doubled = err * 2;
    if (doubled >= dy) { err += dy;x += sx; }
    if (doubled <= dx) { err += dx;y += sy; }
  }
}
export function softBrushCap(ctx, point, width, color) {
  const radius = width / 2, x = Math.floor(point.x) + (width % 2 ? .5 : 0), y = Math.floor(point.y) + (width % 2 ? .5 : 0), rgb = hexRGB(color);
  const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, Math.max(0, radius - .6), x, y, radius);
  gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rgb.join(',')},1)`);gradient.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${rgb.join(',')},0)`);
  ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle = gradient;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
export function maskBoundary(mask, width, height, offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0) {
  const edges = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    if (!mask[y * width + x]) continue;
    const px = x + offsetX, py = y + offsetY;
    if (!y || !mask[(y - 1) * width + x]) edges.push([px, py, px + 1, py]);
    if (y === height - 1 || !mask[(y + 1) * width + x]) edges.push([px, py + 1, px + 1, py + 1]);
    if (!x || !mask[y * width + x - 1]) edges.push([px, py, px, py + 1]);
    if (x === width - 1 || !mask[y * width + x + 1]) edges.push([px + 1, py, px + 1, py + 1]);
  }
  return edges;
}
// Polygon masks operate on pixel centres, with either complete inclusion or none.
export function polygonMask(width, height, points, offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0) {
  const mask = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let row = 0; row < height; row++) {
    const y = row + offsetY + .5, intersections = [];
    for (let index = 0, previous = points.length - 1; index < points.length; previous = index++) {
      const a = points[previous], b = points[index];
      if ((a.y > y) !== (b.y > y)) intersections.push(a.x + (y - a.y) * (b.x - a.x) / (b.y - a.y));
    }
    intersections.sort((a,b) => a-b);
    for (let index = 0; index + 1 < intersections.length; index += 2) {
      const left = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(intersections[index] - offsetX - .5)), right = Math.min(width - 1, Math.floor(intersections[index+1] - offsetX - .5));
      for (let x = left; x <= right; x++) mask[row * width + x] = 1;
    }
  }
  return mask;
}

export function paintRoundPath(context,points,width,color) {
  if(!points.length)return;
  const size=Math.max(1,Math.round(width)),align=value=>Math.floor(value)+(size%2?.5:0),path=[];
  for(const point of points){const next={x:align(point.x),y:align(point.y)},last=path.at(-1);if(last&&last.x===next.x&&last.y===next.y)continue;const previous=path.at(-2);if(previous&&(last.x-previous.x)*(next.y-last.y)===(last.y-previous.y)*(next.x-last.x)&&(last.x-previous.x)*(next.x-last.x)+(last.y-previous.y)*(next.y-last.y)>=0)path.pop();path.push(next);}
  context.save();context.strokeStyle=color;context.fillStyle=color;context.lineWidth=size;context.lineCap='round';context.lineJoin='round';
  context.beginPath();context.moveTo(path[0].x,path[0].y);for(const point of path.slice(1))context.lineTo(point.x,point.y);
  if(path.every(point=>point.x===path[0].x&&point.y===path[0].y)){context.arc(path[0].x,path[0].y,size/2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();}else context.stroke();
  context.restore();
}

import { canvas } from "./raster.js";
let worker;
let nextId = 0;
const pending = new Map();
export function resample(source, w, h, mode = "lanczos") {
  w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w));
  h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h));
  if (w === source.width && h === source.height) return Promise.resolve(source);
  if (w * h > 64000000) throw new Error("Object too large.");
  if (!worker) {
    worker = new Worker(new URL("./resample.worker.js", import.meta.url), {
      type: "module",
    });
    worker.onmessage = ({ data: m }) => {
      const p = pending.get(m.id);
      if (!p) return;
      pending.delete(m.id);
      if (m.error) p.reject(new Error(m.error));
      else {
        const c = canvas(p.w, p.h);
        c.getContext("2d").putImageData(
          new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(m.pixels), p.w, p.h),
          0,
          0,
        );
        p.resolve(c);
      }
    };
    worker.onerror = (e) => {
      for (const p of pending.values()) p.reject(new Error(e.message));
      pending.clear();
      worker.terminate();
      worker = null;
    };
  }
  const pixels = source
    .getContext("2d")
    .getImageData(0, 0, source.width, source.height).data;
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const id = ++nextId;
    pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, w, h });
    worker.postMessage(
      {
        id,
        pixels: pixels.buffer,
        sw: source.width,
        sh: source.height,
        dw: w,
        dh: h,
        mode,
      },
      [pixels.buffer],
    );
  });
}

const sinc = (x) =>
  Math.abs(x) < 1e-8 ? 1 : Math.sin(Math.PI * x) / (Math.PI * x);
const kernel = (x) => (Math.abs(x) >= 3 ? 0 : sinc(x) * sinc(x / 3));
function weights(input, output) {
  const scale = input / output,
    spread = Math.max(1, scale),
    radius = 3 * spread,
    result = [];
  for (let x = 0; x < output; x++) {
    const center = (x + 0.5) * scale - 0.5,
      start = Math.ceil(center - radius),
      end = Math.floor(center + radius),
      list = [];
    let sum = 0;
    for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
      const w = kernel((center - k) / spread);
      if (w === 0) continue;
      list.push([Math.min(input - 1, Math.max(0, k)), w]);
      sum += w;
    }
    result.push(list.map(([i, w]) => [i, w / sum]));
  }
  return result;
}
export function resamplePixels(data, sw, sh, dw, dh, mode = "lanczos") {
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(dw * dh * 4);
  if (mode === "nearest") {
    for (let y = 0; y < dh; y++)
      for (let x = 0; x < dw; x++) {
        const i =
          (Math.min(sh - 1, Math.floor(((y + 0.5) * sh) / dh)) * sw +
            Math.min(sw - 1, Math.floor(((x + 0.5) * sw) / dw))) *
          4;
        out.set(data.subarray(i, i + 4), (y * dw + x) * 4);
      }
    return out;
  }
  // Separable Lanczos3 in premultiplied alpha avoids dark transparent halos.
  const wx = weights(sw, dw),
    wy = weights(sh, dh),
    temp = new Float32Array(dw * sh * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < sh; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < dw; x++) {
      const o = (y * dw + x) * 4;
      for (const [i, w] of wx[x]) {
        const s = (y * sw + i) * 4,
          a = data[s + 3] / 255;
        temp[o] += data[s] * a * w;
        temp[o + 1] += data[s + 1] * a * w;
        temp[o + 2] += data[s + 2] * a * w;
        temp[o + 3] += a * w;
      }
    }
  for (let y = 0; y < dh; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < dw; x++) {
      let r = 0,
        g = 0,
        b = 0,
        a = 0;
      for (const [i, w] of wy[y]) {
        const s = (i * dw + x) * 4;
        r += temp[s] * w;
        g += temp[s + 1] * w;
        b += temp[s + 2] * w;
        a += temp[s + 3] * w;
      }
      const o = (y * dw + x) * 4;
      if (a > 1e-6) {
        out[o] = r / a;
        out[o + 1] = g / a;
        out[o + 2] = b / a;
        out[o + 3] = a * 255;
      }
    }
  return out;
}

export function fontCSS(style) {
  const family = style.font || 'Segoe UI', pixels = style.fontUnit === 'pt' ? pointsToPixels(Number(style.fontSize) || 12) : Number(style.fontSize) || 20;
  const fallback = /Serif|Roman|Georgia|Garamond|Cambria|Baskerville|Book Antiqua|Palatino|Lora|Merriweather/i.test(family) ? 'serif' : /Mono|Consolas|Courier/i.test(family) ? 'monospace' : 'sans-serif';

export function coalesceRuns(runs) {
  const result = [];
  for (const run of runs) {
    if (!run.text) continue;
    const previous = result.at(-1);
    if (previous && runStyleKeys.every(key => previous[key] === run[key])) previous.text += run.text;
    else result.push({ ...run });
  }
  return result;
}
export function textRuns(object) {
  const base = runStyle(object);
  if (Array.isArray(object.textRuns) && object.textRuns.map(run => run.text).join('') === (object.text || '')) return coalesceRuns(object.textRuns.map(run => ({ ...base, ...run })));
  return [{ ...base, text: object.text || '' }];
}
export function formatRuns(runs, start, end, patch) {
  let offset = 0;const result = [];
  for (const run of runs) {
    const left = Math.max(0,start-offset), right = Math.min(run.text.length,end-offset);
    if (right > left) {
      result.push({ ...run, text: run.text.slice(0,left) });
      result.push({ ...run, ...patch, text: run.text.slice(left,right) });
      result.push({ ...run, text: run.text.slice(right) });
    } else result.push({ ...run });
    offset += run.text.length;
  }
  return coalesceRuns(result);
}

export function paintRichText(context,layout) {
  const ink=canvas(layout.width,layout.height),glyphs=ink.getContext('2d'),decorations=[];

function polygon(ctx, points) {
  ctx.moveTo(...points[0]);
  for (const p of points.slice(1)) ctx.lineTo(...p);
  ctx.closePath();
}
export function shapePath(ctx, name, x, y, w, h) {
  const cx = x + w / 2,
    cy = y + h / 2;
  if (name === "line") {
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h);
    return;
  }
  if (name === "curve") {
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      x + w * 0.25,
      y + h * 1.2,
      x + w * 0.75,
      y - h * 0.2,
      x + w,
      y + h,
    );
    return;
  }
  if (name === "rectangle") ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
  else if (name === "rounded")
    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, Math.min(Math.abs(w), Math.abs(h)) * 0.15);
  else if (name === "ellipse")
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, Math.abs(w / 2), Math.abs(h / 2), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  else if (name === "triangle")
    polygon(ctx, [
      [cx, y],
      [x + w, y + h],
      [x, y + h],
    ]);
  else if (name === "rightTriangle")
    polygon(ctx, [
      [x, y],
      [x + w, y + h],
      [x, y + h],
    ]);
  else if (name === "diamond")
    polygon(ctx, [
      [cx, y],
      [x + w, cy],
      [cx, y + h],
      [x, cy],
    ]);
  else if (["pentagon", "hexagon"].includes(name)) {
    const n = name === "pentagon" ? 5 : 6;
    polygon(
      ctx,
      Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [
        cx + (Math.cos(-Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI * 2) / n) * w) / 2,
        cy + (Math.sin(-Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI * 2) / n) * h) / 2,
      ]),
    );
  } else if (name.startsWith("star")) {
    const n = Number(name.slice(4));
    polygon(
      ctx,
      Array.from({ length: n * 2 }, (_, i) => {
        const r = i % 2 ? 0.4 : 1;
        return [
          cx + ((Math.cos(-Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI) / n) * w) / 2) * r,
          cy + ((Math.sin(-Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI) / n) * h) / 2) * r,
        ];
      }),
    );
  } else if (name.startsWith("arrow")) {
    const points = [
      [0, 0.3],
      [0.6, 0.3],
      [0.6, 0],
      [1, 0.5],
      [0.6, 1],
      [0.6, 0.7],
      [0, 0.7],
    ];
    polygon(
      ctx,
      points.map(([a, b]) => {
        if (name === "arrowLeft") a = 1 - a;
        if (name === "arrowUp") [a, b] = [b, 1 - a];
        if (name === "arrowDown") [a, b] = [b, a];
        return [x + a * w, y + b * h];
      }),
    );
  } else if (name === "heart") {
    ctx.moveTo(cx, y + h);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      x - w * 0.3,
      y + h * 0.5,
      x,
      y - h * 0.2,
      cx,
      y + h * 0.25,
    );
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + w, y - h * 0.2, x + w * 1.3, y + h * 0.5, cx, y + h);
  } else if (name === "cloud") {
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.2, y + h * 0.8);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      x - w * 0.1,
      y + h * 0.8,
      x,
      y + h * 0.3,
      x + w * 0.2,
      y + h * 0.4,
    );
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      x + w * 0.1,
      y - h * 0.1,
      x + w * 0.7,
      y - h * 0.1,
      x + w * 0.7,
      y + h * 0.3,
    );
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      x + w * 1.2,
      y + h * 0.1,
      x + w * 1.2,
      y + h * 0.9,
      x + w * 0.8,
      y + h * 0.8,
    );
    ctx.closePath();
  } else if (name === "callout") speechBubblePath(ctx, x, y, w, h);
}
export const bubbleGeometry = { radius: 9, tailWidth: 30, tailHeight: 46, tailInset: 40 };
export function tailGeometry(object,bodyWidth) {
  const custom=Number.isFinite(object.tailTipY),width=Math.max(2,Math.min(bodyWidth-20,Number(object.tailWidth)||(custom?18:30)));
  const left=Math.max(9,Math.min(bodyWidth-9-width,Number(object.tailPosition)||(custom?28:40)));
  return {width,left,tipX:Number.isFinite(object.tailTipX)?object.tailTipX:Math.max(2,left-(custom?14:35)),tipY:custom?Math.max(4,Math.min(1024,object.tailTipY)):46};
}
export function speechBubblePath(ctx, x, y, w, h, fixed = false) {
  const custom=typeof fixed==='object'?fixed:null,tail=custom?.tipY||bubbleGeometry.tailHeight;
  const bottom = y + (fixed ? Math.max(18, h - tail) : h * .76),
    r = fixed ? Math.min(bubbleGeometry.radius, w / 2, (bottom - y) / 2) : Math.min(w * .09, h * .14, 20);
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, bottom - r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, bottom, x + w - r, bottom);
  if(custom) {
    const left=x+custom.left,right=left+custom.width,tip=x+custom.tipX,depth=custom.tipY;
    ctx.lineTo(right,bottom);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(right-depth*.12,bottom+depth*.5,tip+custom.width*.6,bottom+depth,tip,bottom+depth);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(tip+custom.width*.35,bottom+depth*.85,left-depth*.08,bottom+depth*.35,left,bottom);
  } else if (fixed) {
    const left = x + Math.max(r, Math.min(bubbleGeometry.tailInset, w - r - bubbleGeometry.tailWidth)),
      right = left + bubbleGeometry.tailWidth, tip = Math.max(x + 2, left - 35), tail = bubbleGeometry.tailHeight;
    ctx.lineTo(right, bottom);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(right - 10, bottom + tail * .72, left - 5, bottom + tail * 1.12, tip, bottom + tail);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(left - 20, bottom + tail * .9, left - 5, bottom + tail * .42, left, bottom);
  } else {
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * .28, bottom);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + w * .23, y + h * .96, x + w * .13, y + h * 1.04, x + w * .02, y + h * .98);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + w * .13, y + h * .95, x + w * .16, y + h * .87, x + w * .17, bottom);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, bottom); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, bottom, x, bottom - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
}
export function drawShape(ctx, name, a, b, opts) {
  if(['handLine','handCurve'].includes(name)){drawPointingLine(ctx,name,a,b,opts);return;}
  if (!["line", "curve", "polygon"].includes(name)) {
    const start = { x: Math.min(a.x, b.x), y: Math.min(a.y, b.y) },
      end = { x: Math.max(a.x, b.x), y: Math.max(a.y, b.y) };
    a = start;
    b = end;
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineWidth = opts.width;
  ctx.strokeStyle = opts.color;
  ctx.fillStyle = opts.background;
  ctx.lineJoin = "miter";
  ctx.lineCap = "butt";
  ctx.beginPath();
  if (name === "polygon" && opts.points?.length) {
    polygon(
      ctx,
      opts.points.map((p) => [p.x, p.y]),
    );
  } else if (name === "curve" && opts.controls) {
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      opts.controls[0].x,
      opts.controls[0].y,
      opts.controls[1].x,
      opts.controls[1].y,
      b.x,
      b.y,
    );
  } else if (name === "curve") {
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
  } else shapePath(ctx, name, a.x, a.y, b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
  if (opts.fill !== "none" && !["line", "curve"].includes(name)) ctx.fill();
  if (opts.outline !== "none") ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawPointingLine(context,name,a,b,options) {
  const controls=options.controls,curve=name==='handCurve'&&controls?.length===2;
  const sample=t=>{
    if(!curve)return {x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t};
    const u=1-t;return {x:u*u*u*a.x+3*u*u*t*controls[0].x+3*u*t*t*controls[1].x+t*t*t*b.x,y:u*u*u*a.y+3*u*u*t*controls[0].y+3*u*t*t*controls[1].y+t*t*t*b.y};
  };
  const length=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)+(curve?Math.hypot(controls[0].x-a.x,controls[0].y-a.y)+Math.hypot(controls[1].x-b.x,controls[1].y-b.y):0);
  const count=Math.max(8,Math.min(4096,Math.ceil(length/2))),amplitude=Math.max(.65,Math.min(2.2,options.width*.32));
  context.save();context.lineWidth=options.width;context.lineCap='round';context.lineJoin='round';context.strokeStyle=options.color;context.beginPath();
  for(let index=0;index<=count;index++){
    const t=index/count,point=sample(t),ahead=sample(Math.min(1,t+.001)),behind=sample(Math.max(0,t-.001)),dx=ahead.x-behind.x,dy=ahead.y-behind.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    const wobble=options.handWobble?amplitude*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*(Math.sin(t*length*.075)+.4*Math.sin(t*length*.21)):0;
    const x=point.x-dy/distance*wobble,y=point.y+dx/distance*wobble;index?context.lineTo(x,y):context.moveTo(x,y);
  }
  context.stroke();
  let tangent=curve?{x:b.x-controls[1].x,y:b.y-controls[1].y}:{x:b.x-a.x,y:b.y-a.y};
  if(Math.hypot(tangent.x,tangent.y)<.001){const near=sample(.98);tangent={x:b.x-near.x,y:b.y-near.y};}
  context.translate(b.x,b.y);context.rotate(Math.atan2(tangent.y,tangent.x));
  const scale=Math.max(.65,Math.min(5,options.width/3));context.scale(scale,scale);context.fillStyle='#000000';
  // The finger lies along the shaft; the small rounded palm hangs below it.
  context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-9,-1.5);context.lineTo(1,-1.5);
  context.quadraticCurveTo(2.5,-1.5,2.5,0);context.quadraticCurveTo(2.5,1.5,1,1.5);
  context.lineTo(-5,1.5);context.quadraticCurveTo(-5,5,-8,5);
  context.quadraticCurveTo(-12,5,-12,2);context.quadraticCurveTo(-12,-1,-9,-1.5);
  context.closePath();context.fill();context.restore();
}

export const zoomLevels = [0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8];
export function nearestZoom(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 1;
  return zoomLevels.reduce((best, level) => Math.abs(level - value) < Math.abs(best - value) ? level : best);
}
export function stepZoom(value, direction) {
  const index = zoomLevels.indexOf(nearestZoom(value));
  return zoomLevels[Math.max(0, Math.min(zoomLevels.length - 1, index + Math.sign(direction)))];
}
export function fitZoom(value) {
  return [...zoomLevels].reverse().find(level => level <= value) || zoomLevels[0];
}

export function selectionBounds(objects) {
  if (!objects.length) return null;
  if (objects.length === 1) return objects[0];
  const points = objects.flatMap((o) =>
    [
      [0, 0],
      [o.width, 0],
      [o.width, o.height],
      [0, o.height],

}

    const oh = Math.max(1, Math.min(d.height * z - oy, this.viewport.clientHeight - Math.max(0, 7 - this.viewport.scrollTop)));
    this.overlay.width = Math.ceil(ow * ratio); this.overlay.height = Math.ceil(oh * ratio);
    Object.assign(this.overlay.style, { width: ow + 'px', height: oh + 'px', left: ox + 'px', top: oy + 'px' });
    this.stage.style.width = d.width * z + "px";
    this.stage.style.height = d.height * z + "px";
    const ctx = this.display.getContext("2d");
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, d.width, d.height);
    d.color2=this.app.color2;
    d.layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{if(layer.visible)drawLayer(ctx,layer,d.layerKey(layer),d.renderRevision);});
    const over = this.overlay.getContext("2d");
    over.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    over.clearRect(0, 0, this.overlay.width, this.overlay.height);
    over.setTransform(ratio * z, 0, 0, ratio * z, -ox * ratio, -oy * ratio);
    if (this.app.prefs.grid && z >= 2) {
      over.save();
      over.strokeStyle = "#64789235";
      over.lineWidth = 1 / z;
      over.beginPath();
      for (let x = 0; x <= d.width; x++) {
        over.moveTo(x, 0);
        over.lineTo(x, d.height);
      }
      for (let y = 0; y <= d.height; y++) {
        over.moveTo(0, y);
        over.lineTo(d.width, y);
      }
      over.stroke();
      over.restore();
    }
    if (this.drag?.type === 'shape') this.drawShapePreview(over,this.app.shape,this.drag.start,this.drag.end,{width:this.app.width,color:this.drag.color,background:this.drag.background,outline:this.app.outline,fill:this.app.shapeFill,handWobble:this.app.prefs.handWobble});
    if (this.pendingShape) { const shape=this.pendingShape;this.drawShapePreview(over,shape.name,shape.start,shape.end,{...shape.options,controls:shape.controls,points:shape.points}); }
    if (this.app.tool==='zoom' && this.hover) {
      const area=this.zoomArea(this.hover);over.save();over.lineWidth=1/z;over.strokeStyle='#fff';over.strokeRect(area.x,area.y,area.width,area.height);over.strokeStyle='#29394c';over.setLineDash([5/z,3/z]);over.strokeRect(area.x,area.y,area.width,area.height);over.restore();
    }
    if (this.drag?.type === "selection" || this.drag?.type === 'text-box') {
      over.save();
      over.strokeStyle = "#006ce3";
      over.fillStyle = "#0078ff12";
      over.lineWidth = 1 / z;
      over.setLineDash([5 / z, 3 / z]);
      over.beginPath();
      if (this.drag.free) {
        this.drawFreePreview(over,this.drag);
      } else {
        const r = this.rect(this.drag.start, this.drag.end);
        over.rect(r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height);
      }
      if(!this.drag.free){over.stroke();over.fill();}
      over.restore();
    }
    const selected = d.selectedObjects;
    const bounds = selectionBounds(selected);
    if (bounds && this.drag?.type!=='move') {
      this.drawSelection(over, bounds);
      if(selected.length===1&&selected[0].type==='text'&&selected[0].bubble){
        const tip=this.tailPoint(selected[0]),s=4/z;over.save();over.translate(tip.x,tip.y);over.rotate(Math.PI/4);over.fillStyle='#fff';over.strokeStyle='#0078ff';over.lineWidth=1/z;over.fillRect(-s,-s,2*s,2*s);over.strokeRect(-s,-s,2*s,2*s);over.restore();
      }
      if (selected.length > 1)
        for (const o of selected) this.drawOutline(over, o, "#0078ed80");
    }
    if (this.selectionRect && this.app.tool === "crop") {
      over.save();
      over.strokeStyle = "#0078ed";
      over.lineWidth = 1 / z;
      over.setLineDash([5 / z, 4 / z]);
      const r = this.selectionRect;
      over.strokeRect(r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height);
      over.restore();
    }
    this.drawRulers();
    this.updateCursor(this.hover);
    document.querySelector("#dimensions-status span").textContent =
      d.width + " × " + d.height + " px";
    document.querySelector("#zoom-percent").textContent =
      z * 100 + "%";
    document.querySelector("#zoom-slider").value = zoomLevels.indexOf(nearestZoom(z));
    this.app.textEditor?.position();
  }
  drawShapePreview(context,name,start,end,options) {
    const key=JSON.stringify([name,start,end,options]);
    try {
      if(this.preview?.key!==key) {const properties=shapeProperties(name,start,end,options);this.doc.assertAllocation(properties.width*properties.height*12);this.preview={key,object:{...properties,source:shapeSource(properties),angle:0,flipH:false,flipV:false}};}
      drawObject(context,this.preview.object);
    } catch(error) { if(this.previewError!==error.message){this.previewError=error.message;this.app.toast(error.message);} }
  }
  contextMenu(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if(this.doc.selectedObjects.length && this.handleAt(this.point(event)))this.app.selectionMenu(event.clientX,event.clientY);
  }
  drawFreePreview(context,drag) {
    if(drag.path.length<3)return;
    const points=drag.path,x=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.min(...points.map(point=>point.x)))),y=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.min(...points.map(point=>point.y)))),
      width=Math.max(1,Math.min(this.doc.width-x,Math.ceil(Math.max(...points.map(point=>point.x)))-x)),height=Math.max(1,Math.min(this.doc.height-y,Math.ceil(Math.max(...points.map(point=>point.y)))-y));
    try {
      if(drag.pixelPreview?.count!==points.length) {
        this.doc.assertAllocation(width*height*6);
        const mask=polygonMask(width,height,points,x,y),source=canvas(width,height),ctx=source.getContext('2d'),pixels=ctx.createImageData(width,height);
        for(let index=0;index<mask.length;index++)if(mask[index])pixels.data.set([0,108,227,24],index*4);
        ctx.putImageData(pixels,0,0);drag.pixelPreview={count:points.length,source,mask,x,y,width,height,edges:maskBoundary(mask,width,height,x,y)};
      }
      const preview=drag.pixelPreview;context.save();context.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;context.drawImage(preview.source,preview.x,preview.y);context.setLineDash([]);context.fillStyle='#006ce3';
      const thickness=1/this.app.zoom;
      for(const[x1,y1,x2,y2]of preview.edges)context.fillRect(x1,y1,Math.max(thickness,x2-x1),Math.max(thickness,y2-y1));
      context.restore();
    } catch(error) {if(drag.previewError!==error.message){drag.previewError=error.message;this.app.toast(error.message);}}
  }
  zoomArea(point) {
    const target=nearestZoom(this.app.zoom*2),ratio=target/this.app.zoom,width=Math.min(this.doc.width,this.viewport.clientWidth/this.app.zoom)/ratio,height=Math.min(this.doc.height,this.viewport.clientHeight/this.app.zoom)/ratio;
    return {x:Math.max(0,Math.min(this.doc.width-width,point.x-width/2)),y:Math.max(0,Math.min(this.doc.height-height,point.y-height/2)),width,height,target};
  }
  drawOutline(ctx, o, color = "#4081b8") {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 / (this.app.zoom*(window.devicePixelRatio||1));
    ctx.setLineDash([3 / this.app.zoom, 5 / this.app.zoom]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    [
      [0, 0],
      [o.width, 0],
      [o.width, o.height],
      [0, o.height],
    ].forEach(([x, y], i) => {
      const raw = worldPoint(o, x, y), factor = this.app.zoom * (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      const p = { x: (Math.round(raw.x * factor) + 0.5) / factor, y: (Math.round(raw.y * factor) + 0.5) / factor };
      i ? ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y) : ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
    });
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  drawSelection(ctx, o) {
    o=selectionFrame(o,this.app.zoom,this.doc.width,this.doc.height);
    this.drawOutline(ctx, o);
    const z = this.app.zoom,
      s = 4 / z, factor=z*(window.devicePixelRatio||1),pixel=1/factor;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineWidth = pixel;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#56788f";
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    for (const p of handlePoints(o)) {
      const x = Math.round((p.x-s/2)*factor)/factor, y = Math.round((p.y-s/2)*factor)/factor;
      ctx.fillRect(x,y,s,s);ctx.strokeRect(x+pixel/2,y+pixel/2,s-pixel,s-pixel);
    }
    const {anchor:top,point:rotate}=this.rotationHandle(o);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#0078ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    const distance=Math.hypot(rotate.x-top.x,rotate.y-top.y)||1;
    ctx.moveTo(top.x+(rotate.x-top.x)*s/2/distance,top.y+(rotate.y-top.y)*s/2/distance);
    ctx.lineTo(rotate.x, rotate.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rotate.x, rotate.y, 6 / z, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0078ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rotate.x, rotate.y, 3 / z, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  tailPoint(object) {const layout=textLayout(object);return worldPoint(object,layout.bodyX+layout.tail.tipX,layout.bodyHeight+layout.tail.tipY-((Number(object.bubbleWidth)||3)/2+1));}
  handleAt(p) {
    const selected=this.doc.selectedObjects;
    if(selected.length===1&&selected[0].type==='text'&&selected[0].bubble){const tip=this.tailPoint(selected[0]);if(Math.hypot(p.x-tip.x,p.y-tip.y)<8/this.app.zoom)return {type:'tail',bounds:selected[0]};}
    const bounds = selectionBounds(this.doc.selectedObjects);
    if (!bounds) return null;
    const frame=selectionFrame(bounds,this.app.zoom,this.doc.width,this.doc.height),rotation = this.rotationHandle(frame).point;
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - rotation.x, p.y - rotation.y) < 10 / this.app.zoom)
      return { type: "rotate", bounds };
    const hs = handlePoints(frame);
    for (let i = 0; i < hs.length; i++)
      if (Math.hypot(p.x - hs[i].x, p.y - hs[i].y) < 8 / this.app.zoom)
        return { type: "resize", index: i, bounds };
    const local=localPoint(bounds,p.x,p.y),pad=4/this.app.zoom;
    if(local.x>=-pad&&local.y>=-pad&&local.x<=bounds.width+pad&&local.y<=bounds.height+pad)return {type:"move",bounds};
    return null;
  }
  rotationHandle(bounds) {
    const margin=7/this.app.zoom,gap=25/this.app.zoom;
    for(const[ax,ay,rx,ry]of [[bounds.width/2,0,bounds.width/2,-gap],[bounds.width/2,bounds.height,bounds.width/2,bounds.height+gap],[bounds.width,bounds.height/2,bounds.width+gap,bounds.height/2],[0,bounds.height/2,-gap,bounds.height/2]]) {
      const point=worldPoint(bounds,rx,ry);
      if(point.x>=margin&&point.y>=margin&&point.x<=this.doc.width-margin&&point.y<=this.doc.height-margin)return{point,anchor:worldPoint(bounds,ax,ay)};
    }
    const point=worldPoint(bounds,bounds.width/2,-gap),inset=14/this.app.zoom;
    return{anchor:worldPoint(bounds,bounds.width/2,0),point:{x:Math.max(inset,Math.min(this.doc.width-inset,point.x)),y:Math.max(inset,Math.min(this.doc.height-inset,point.y))}};
  }
  updateCursor(p) {
    let cursor = cursors[this.app.tool] || "crosshair";
    if (p && (this.doc.selectedObjects.length || ["select", "free", "move", "shape", "text"].includes(this.app.tool))) {
      const h = this.handleAt(p);
      if (h) {
        cursor =
          h.type === 'tail' ? 'crosshair' : h.type === "rotate"
            ? "grab"
            : h.type === "move"
              ? "move"
              : [
                  "nwse-resize",
                  "ns-resize",
                  "nesw-resize",
                  "ew-resize",
                  "nwse-resize",
                  "ns-resize",
                  "nesw-resize",
                  "ew-resize",
                ][h.index];
      } else if (this.doc.hit(p.x, p.y)) cursor = "move";
    }
    if (this.drag?.type === "rotate") cursor = "grabbing";
    this.overlay.style.cursor = cursor;
    const ghost=document.querySelector('#brush-cursor');
    if(p && this.pointerInside && ['brush','pencil','eraser'].includes(this.app.tool) && !this.drag?.type?.includes('resize')) {
      const bounds=stampBounds(p,this.app.width),zoom=this.app.zoom;ghost.className=this.app.tool==='eraser'?'eraser-ghost':'round-ghost';
      Object.assign(ghost.style,{display:'block',left:bounds.x*zoom+'px',top:bounds.y*zoom+'px',width:bounds.width*zoom+'px',height:bounds.height*zoom+'px'});
      ghost.style.setProperty('--ink',this.app.tool==='eraser'?this.app.color2:this.app.color1);
    } else ghost.style.display='none';
  }
  rect(a, b) {
    return {
      x: Math.min(a.x, b.x),
      y: Math.min(a.y, b.y),
      width: Math.abs(b.x - a.x),
      height: Math.abs(b.y - a.y),
    };
  }
  pointerDown(e) {
    if ((e.button !== 0 && e.button !== 2) || this.app.busy) return;
    const pressed=this.point(e);
    if(e.button===2 && this.doc.selectedObjects.length && this.handleAt(pressed))return;
    e.preventDefault();
    this.overlay.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    this.overlay.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    const p = this.point(e);
    this.hover = p;
    const a = this.app,
      d = this.doc,
      color = e.button === 2 ? a.color2 : a.color1,
      background = e.button === 2 ? a.color1 : a.color2;
    try {
      if (a.tool === "shape" && this.pendingShape) {
        const s = this.pendingShape;
        if (['curve','handCurve'].includes(s.name)) {
          s.controls[s.phase] = p;
          this.drag = { type: "curve-bend", start: p, end: p };
        } else {
          if (Math.hypot(p.x - s.points.at(-1).x, p.y - s.points.at(-1).y) > 1)
            s.points.push(p);
          this.drag = { type: "polygon-point", start: p, end: p };
        }
        this.requestRender();
        return;
      }
      a.layerFocused = false;
      const groupRegion=!!this.groupRegionArmed&&['select','free'].includes(a.tool);
      if(groupRegion){a.finishSelection();d.selected=[];this.groupRegionArmed=false;}
      const existingHandle = groupRegion?null:this.handleAt(p);
      const replacingSelection=!!d.selectedObjects.length&&!existingHandle&&!e.ctrlKey&&a.prefs.selectionMode==='paint';
      if(replacingSelection)a.finishSelection();
      if(a.textEditor?.active&&!existingHandle)a.textEditor.finish();
      if (["select", "free", "move", "crop"].includes(a.tool) || existingHandle) {
        let handle = groupRegion?null:this.handleAt(p);
        const hit = groupRegion?null:d.hit(p.x, p.y);
        if (hit && !handle) {
          d.activeLayerId = hit.layer.id;
          if(!hit.layer.group)d.editGroupId=null;
          const group = hit.object.group;
          if(hit.layer.group&&!e.ctrlKey&&!e.shiftKey){d.selectLayers(d.layers.filter(layer=>layer.group===hit.layer.group).map(layer=>layer.id));}
          else if (e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey) {
            d.selected = d.selected.includes(hit.object.id)
              ? d.selected.filter((id) => id !== hit.object.id)
              : [...d.selected, hit.object.id];
          } else {
            d.selected = group
              ? d.objects.filter((o) => o.group === group).map((o) => o.id)
              : [hit.object.id];
          }
          handle = this.handleAt(p);
          if (hit.object.type === 'shape') {
            a.width = hit.object.shapeStyle.width;a.outline = hit.object.shapeStyle.outline;a.shapeFill = hit.object.shapeStyle.fill;
            document.querySelector('#outline').value = a.outline;document.querySelector('#shape-fill').value = a.shapeFill;
          }
          a.changedUI();
          a.updateLayers();
          if (hit.object.type === "text") a.switchTab("text");
        }
        if (handle && d.selectedObjects.length) {
          if (
            d.layers.some(
              (l) =>
                l.locked && l.objects.some((o) => d.selected.includes(o.id)),
            )
          )
            throw new Error("This layer is locked.");
          const originals = d.selectedObjects.map((o) => ({ ...o }));
          this.drag = {
            ...handle,
            bounds: { ...handle.bounds },
            start: p,
            originals,
            before: d.metadata(),
            lastPosition: { x: 0, y: 0 }, trailLayers: new Set(),
          };
          this.requestRender();
          return;
        }
        if (a.tool === "move") {
          d.selected = [];
          a.changedUI();
          return;
        }
        d.selected = [];
        this.selectionRect = null;
        this.drag = {
          type: "selection",
          start: {x:Math.round(p.x),y:Math.round(p.y)},
          end: {x:Math.round(p.x),y:Math.round(p.y)},
          path: [{x:Math.floor(p.x),y:Math.floor(p.y)}],
          free: a.tool === "free",
        };
      } else if (["pencil", "brush", "eraser"].includes(a.tool)) {
        if (d.activeLayer.locked) throw new Error("This layer is locked.");
        if (!d.activeLayer.visible)
          throw new Error("Show the active layer before painting.");
        this.drag = {
          type: "paint",
          start: p,
          last: p,
          edit: d.beginLinkedRaster(),
          color,
          background,
          right: e.button === 2,
          initialWidth: a.width, brush: a.brush, tool: a.tool,
        };
        this.stroke(p, p);

      } else if (a.tool === "fill") {
        const edit=d.beginLinkedRaster();let changed=false;
        for(const raster of edit.edits){raster.capture(0,0,d.width,d.height);changed=floodFill(raster.layer.canvas,p.x,p.y,color,a.prefs.fillTolerance)||changed;}
        if(changed)edit.commit('Fill');else edit.cancel();
      } else if (a.tool === "dropper") {
        const c = d.composite(a.color2);
        const picked = colorAt(c, p.x, p.y);
        if (e.button === 2) a.color2 = picked;
        else a.color1 = picked;
        a.updateColors();
      } else if (a.tool === "text") {
        if (d.activeLayer.locked || !d.activeLayer.visible) throw new Error('Show and unlock the active layer before adding text.');
        this.drag = { type: 'text-box', start: p, end: p,replacingSelection };
      } else if (a.tool === "zoom") {
        const area=this.zoomArea(p);
        this.setZoom(nearestZoom(a.zoom * (e.button === 2 ? .5 : 2)), {
          x: e.clientX,
          y: e.clientY,
        });
        if(e.button===0){this.viewport.scrollLeft=area.x*this.app.zoom+7;this.viewport.scrollTop=area.y*this.app.zoom+7;this.requestRender();}
      } else if (a.tool === "shape") {
        if (d.activeLayer.locked) throw new Error("This layer is locked.");
        this.drag = { type: "shape", start: p, end: p, color, background,replacingSelection };
      }
      this.requestRender();
    } catch (err) {
      a.toast(err.message);
    }
  }
  stroke(a, b) {
    this.doc.invalidateLayers();
    const drag=this.drag,app=this.app,r=app.width/2+3;
    if(app.tool==='brush'&&app.brush==='round'){drag.points||=[a];drag.points.push(b);}
    for(const edit of drag.edit.edits){
      edit.capture(Math.min(a.x,b.x)-r,Math.min(a.y,b.y)-r,Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+2*r,Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+2*r);
      const ctx=edit.layer.canvas.getContext('2d');
      if(app.tool==='brush'&&app.brush==='round'){edit.restoreBefore();paintRoundPath(ctx,drag.points,app.width,drag.color);}
      else if(app.tool==='eraser'&&drag.right)replaceColorSegment(ctx,a,b,app.color1,app.color2,app.width);
      else if(app.tool==='eraser'){ctx.save();if(this.doc.layerTransparency==='alpha'&&this.doc.layers.indexOf(edit.layer)>0)ctx.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';ctx.fillStyle=app.color2;pixelSegment(ctx,a,b,app.width);ctx.restore();}
      else paintSegment(ctx,a,b,{type:app.tool,brush:app.brush,color:drag.color,background:drag.background,width:app.width});
    }
  }

  pointerMove(e) {
    const p = this.point(e);
    this.hover = p;
    this.updateCursor(p);
    document.querySelector("#cursor-status span").textContent =
      Math.floor(p.x) + ", " + Math.floor(p.y) + " px";
    if (this.app.tool === 'zoom') this.requestRender();
    const drag = this.drag;
    if (!drag) return;
    if (drag.type === "curve-bend") {
      this.pendingShape.controls[this.pendingShape.phase] = p;
    } else if (drag.type === "paint") {
      let next = p;
      if (e.shiftKey) next = constrain(drag.start, p);
      const samples = e.getCoalescedEvents?.() || [];
      if (samples.length && !e.shiftKey)
        for (const sample of samples) {
          const q = this.point(sample);
          this.stroke(drag.last, q);
          drag.last = q;
        }
      else {
        this.stroke(drag.last, next);
        drag.last = next;
      }
    } else if (drag.type === "shape") {
      let end = p;
      if (e.shiftKey) {
        if (["line", "curve", "handLine", "handCurve"].includes(this.app.shape))
          end = constrain(drag.start, p);
        else {
          const s = Math.max(
            Math.abs(p.x - drag.start.x),
            Math.abs(p.y - drag.start.y),
          );
          end = {
            x: drag.start.x + Math.sign(p.x - drag.start.x) * s,
            y: drag.start.y + Math.sign(p.y - drag.start.y) * s,
          };
        }
      }
      drag.end = end;
    } else if (drag.type === 'text-box') {
      drag.end = p;
    } else if (drag.type === "selection") {
      drag.end = drag.free?p:{x:Math.round(p.x),y:Math.round(p.y)};
      if(drag.free){const point={x:Math.floor(p.x),y:Math.floor(p.y)},last=drag.path.at(-1);if(point.x!==last.x||point.y!==last.y)drag.path.push(point);}
    } else if(drag.type==='tail') {
      const original=drag.originals[0],object=this.doc.objects.find(object=>object.id===original.id),layout=textLayout(original),local=localPoint(original,p.x,p.y),anchor=worldPoint(original,layout.bodyX,0);
      const candidate={...original,tailWidth:original.tailWidth??30,tailPosition:original.tailPosition??40,tailTipX:Math.max(-1024,Math.min(layout.boxWidth+1024,Math.round(local.x-layout.bodyX))),tailTipY:Math.max(4,Math.min(1024,Math.round(local.y-layout.bodyHeight+((Number(original.bubbleWidth)||3)/2+1))))};
      refreshEditable(candidate);this.doc.assertAllocation(candidate.width*candidate.height*24);
      const next=textLayout(candidate),angle=(candidate.angle||0)*Math.PI/180,dx=next.bodyX-candidate.width/2,dy=-candidate.height/2;
      candidate.x=anchor.x-candidate.width/2-dx*Math.cos(angle)+dy*Math.sin(angle);candidate.y=anchor.y-candidate.height/2-dx*Math.sin(angle)-dy*Math.cos(angle);
      Object.assign(object,candidate);if(this.app.textEditor.active)this.app.textEditor.modified=true;
    } else if (drag.type === "move") {
      const dx = Math.round(p.x - drag.start.x), dy = Math.round(p.y - drag.start.y);
      if (e.shiftKey) this.trail(drag, dx, dy);
      for (const original of drag.originals) {
        const o = this.doc.objects.find(o => o.id === original.id);
        if (o) { o.x = original.x + dx; o.y = original.y + dy; }
      }
      drag.lastPosition = { x: dx, y: dy };
    } else if (drag.type === "resize") this.resizeObjects(p, e.shiftKey);
    else if (drag.type === "rotate") {
      const b = drag.bounds,
        cx = b.x + b.width / 2,
        cy = b.y + b.height / 2,
        initial = Math.atan2(drag.start.y - cy, drag.start.x - cx),
        now = Math.atan2(p.y - cy, p.x - cx);
      let delta = ((now - initial) * 180) / Math.PI;
      if (e.shiftKey) delta = Math.round(delta / 15) * 15;
      const r = (delta * Math.PI) / 180;
      for (const original of drag.originals) {
        const o = this.doc.objects.find((o) => o.id === original.id);
        o.angle = original.angle + delta;
        if (drag.originals.length > 1) {
          const dx = original.x + original.width / 2 - cx,
            dy = original.y + original.height / 2 - cy;
          o.x = cx + dx * Math.cos(r) - dy * Math.sin(r) - o.width / 2;
          o.y = cy + dx * Math.sin(r) + dy * Math.cos(r) - o.height / 2;
        }
      }
    }
    this.requestRender();
  }
  resizeObjects(p, shift) {
    const d = this.drag,
      b = d.bounds,
      local = localPoint(b, p.x, p.y),
      initial=localPoint(b,d.start.x,d.start.y),
      i = d.index,
      affectsX = i !== 1 && i !== 5,
      affectsY = i !== 3 && i !== 7,
      left = [0, 6, 7].includes(i),
      top = [0, 1, 2].includes(i);
    let nw = affectsX
        ? Math.max(1, b.width+(local.x-initial.x)*(left?-1:1))
        : b.width,
      nh = affectsY
        ? Math.max(1, b.height+(local.y-initial.y)*(top?-1:1))
        : b.height;
    if (this.app.prefs.aspectLock || shift) {
      const ratio = b.width / b.height;
      if (!affectsX) nw = nh * ratio;
      else if (!affectsY) nh = nw / ratio;
      else if (nw / b.width > nh / b.height) nh = nw / ratio;
      else nw = nh * ratio;
    }
    const anchor = worldPoint(b, left ? b.width : 0, top ? b.height : 0);
    const angle = (b.angle * Math.PI) / 180,
      ax = left ? nw : 0,
      ay = top ? nh : 0;
    const newCx =
        anchor.x -
        (ax - nw / 2) * Math.cos(angle) +
        (ay - nh / 2) * Math.sin(angle),
      newCy =
        anchor.y -
        (ax - nw / 2) * Math.sin(angle) -
        (ay - nh / 2) * Math.cos(angle);
    const nx = newCx - nw / 2,
      ny = newCy - nh / 2;
    if (d.originals.length === 1) {
      const o = this.doc.objects.find((o) => o.id === d.originals[0].id);
      const candidate = { ...o, x: Math.round(nx), y: Math.round(ny), width: Math.round(nw), height: Math.round(nh),pixelSnapX:0,pixelSnapY:0 };
      if (o.type === 'text') {resizeTextBox(candidate,nw,nh);}
      if (o.type === 'shape') {
        this.doc.assertAllocation(Math.ceil(nw) * Math.ceil(nh) * 12);
        refreshEditable(candidate);
      }
      Object.assign(o, candidate);
    } else
      for (const original of d.originals) {
        const o = this.doc.objects.find((o) => o.id === original.id);
        o.x = nx + ((original.x - b.x) * nw) / b.width;
        o.y = ny + ((original.y - b.y) * nh) / b.height;
        o.width = (original.width * nw) / b.width;
        o.height = (original.height * nh) / b.height;
      }
  }
  pointerUp(e) {
    if (!this.drag) return;
    const drag=this.drag, clickText=drag.type==='move' && Math.hypot(drag.start.x-this.point(e).x,drag.start.y-this.point(e).y)<1 ? this.doc.selectedObjects.find(object=>object.type==='text') : null;
    this.finishDrag();
    if(clickText&&!this.app.textEditor.active)this.app.editText(clickText);
    if (this.overlay.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))
      this.overlay.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  }
  finishDrag() {
    const drag = this.drag;
    if (!drag) return;
    this.drag = null;
    const d = this.doc;
    if(drag.replacingSelection&&['text-box','shape'].includes(drag.type)&&Math.hypot(drag.end.x-drag.start.x,drag.end.y-drag.start.y)<2/this.app.zoom){this.app.changedUI();return;}
    try {
      if (drag.type === "paint") {

        drag.edit.commit(
          this.app.tool === "eraser"
            ? "Erase"
            : this.app.tool === "pencil"
              ? "Pencil stroke"
              : "Brush stroke",
        );
      }
      else if (drag.type === "curve-bend") {
        this.pendingShape.phase++;
        if (this.pendingShape.phase >= 2) this.finishPending();
      } else if (
        drag.type === "shape" &&
        ["curve", "handCurve", "polygon"].includes(this.app.shape)
      ) {
        this.pendingShape = {
          ...drag,
          name: this.app.shape,
          layerId: d.activeLayer.id,
          phase: 0,
          options: {
            width: this.app.width,
            color: drag.color,
            background: drag.background,
            outline: this.app.outline,
            fill: this.app.shapeFill,
            handWobble:this.app.prefs.handWobble,
          },
        };
        if (["curve","handCurve"].includes(this.app.shape)) {
          this.pendingShape.controls = [
            {
              x: drag.start.x + (drag.end.x - drag.start.x) / 3,
              y: drag.start.y + (drag.end.y - drag.start.y) / 3,
            },
            {
              x: drag.start.x + (2 * (drag.end.x - drag.start.x)) / 3,
              y: drag.start.y + (2 * (drag.end.y - drag.start.y)) / 3,
            },
          ];
          this.app.toast(
            "Drag two bend points to shape the curve. Enter commits early.",
          );
        } else {
          this.pendingShape.points = [drag.start, drag.end];
          this.app.toast(
            "Click polygon corners. Double-click or Enter to finish.",
          );
        }
      } else if (drag.type === 'text-box') {
        const rect = this.rect(drag.start, drag.end);
        this.app.textEditor.begin(null, { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: Math.max(120, rect.width), height: Math.max(50, rect.height) });
      } else if (drag.type === "shape") {
        this.createShape(this.app.shape, drag.start, drag.end, { width: this.app.width, color: drag.color, background: drag.background, outline: this.app.outline, fill: this.app.shapeFill,handWobble:this.app.prefs.handWobble });
      } else if (drag.type === "selection") {
        let rect = this.rect(drag.start, drag.end);
        if (drag.free) {
          const xs = drag.path.map((p) => p.x),
            ys = drag.path.map((p) => p.y);
          rect = {
            x: Math.min(...xs),
            y: Math.min(...ys),
            width: Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs),
            height: Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys),
          };
        }
        if (rect.width >= 1 && rect.height >= 1) {
          if (this.app.tool === "crop") {
            this.selectionRect = rect;
          } else {
            d.selectRegion(
              rect,
              drag.free ? drag.path : null,
              this.app.prefs.transparentSelection ? this.app.color2 : null,
              this.app.color2,
            );
            this.app.selectionOrigin = drag.free ? 'free' : 'select';
            this.app.tool = this.app.prefs.selectionMode === 'persistent' ? 'move' : this.app.selectionOrigin;
            this.app.updateTools();
          }
        }
      } else if (drag.type==='tail') {
        if(this.doc.selectedObjects[0]?.source!==drag.originals[0].source)this.app.recordTransform(drag.before,'Aim speech bubble tail');
      } else if (["move", "resize", "rotate"].includes(drag.type)) {
        if(drag.type==='rotate')for(const object of d.selectedObjects)snapQuarterTurn(object);
        const after = d.metadata();
        if (drag.trailLayers?.size ||
          JSON.stringify(
            drag.originals.map((o) => [o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height, o.angle]),
          ) !==
          JSON.stringify(
            d.selectedObjects.map((o) => [
              o.x,
              o.y,
              o.width,
              o.height,
              o.angle,
            ]),
          )
        ) {
          this.app.recordTransform(drag.before,drag.type === 'move' ? 'Move objects' : drag.type === 'resize' ? 'Resize objects' : 'Rotate objects');
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.app.toast(err.message);
    }
    this.app.changedUI();
  }
  finishPending() {
    const s = this.pendingShape;
    if (!s) return;
    this.pendingShape = null;
    const layer = this.doc.layers.find((l) => l.id === s.layerId);
    if (!layer || layer.locked) {
      this.requestRender();
      return;
    }
    const active = this.doc.activeLayerId;
    this.doc.activeLayerId = layer.id;
    this.createShape(s.name, s.start, s.end, { ...s.options, controls: s.controls, points: s.points });
    this.doc.activeLayerId = active;
    this.app.changedUI();
  }
  createShape(name, start, end, options) {
    const properties = shapeProperties(name, start, end, options);
    this.doc.assertAllocation(properties.width * properties.height * 12);
    const source = shapeSource(properties);
    const object = this.doc.insert(source, name, false, properties),command=this.doc.history.undoStack.at(-1);
    command.sessionKey=object.id;command.sessionOpen=true;
    this.app.changedUI();
  }
  trail(drag, dx, dy) {
    this.doc.invalidateLayers();
    const targets = this.doc.layers.filter(l => l.objects.some(o => drag.originals.some(original => original.id === o.id)));
    for (const layer of targets) if (!drag.trailLayers.has(layer.id)) {
      this.doc.assertAllocation(this.doc.width * this.doc.height * 4);
      const previous = layer.canvas, next = canvas(previous.width, previous.height);
      next.getContext('2d').drawImage(previous, 0, 0); layer.canvas = next;
      drag.trailLayers.add(layer.id);
    }
    const from = drag.lastPosition, count = Math.max(Math.abs(dx - from.x), Math.abs(dy - from.y), 1);
    for (let step = 0; step <= count; step++) {
      const sx = Math.round(from.x + (dx - from.x) * step / count), sy = Math.round(from.y + (dy - from.y) * step / count);
      for (const original of drag.originals) {
        const layer = targets.find(l => l.objects.some(o => o.id === original.id));
        if (layer) drawObject(layer.canvas.getContext('2d'), { ...original, x: original.x + sx, y: original.y + sy });
      }
    }
  }
  canvasResizeStart(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const target = e.currentTarget,
      kind = target.dataset.canvasHandle,
      start = {
        x: e.clientX,
        y: e.clientY,
        w: this.doc.width,
        h: this.doc.height,
      };
    target.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    let w = start.w,
      h = start.h;
    const move = (ev) => {
      w =
        kind === "bottom"
          ? start.w
          : Math.max(
              1,
              Math.round(start.w + (ev.clientX - start.x) / this.app.zoom),
            );
      h =
        kind === "right"
          ? start.h
          : Math.max(
              1,
              Math.round(start.h + (ev.clientY - start.y) / this.app.zoom),
            );
      this.stage.style.width = w * this.app.zoom + "px";
      this.stage.style.height = h * this.app.zoom + "px";
      document.querySelector("#dimensions-status span").textContent =
        w + " × " + h + " px";
    };
    const up = (ev) => {
      target.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      target.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      target.removeEventListener("pointercancel", up);
      if (target.hasPointerCapture(ev.pointerId))
        target.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
      try {
        if (w !== start.w || h !== start.h)
          this.doc.resizeCanvas(w, h, this.app.color2);
      } catch (err) {
        this.app.toast(err.message);
      }
      this.app.changedUI();
    };
    target.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
    target.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    target.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
  }
  setZoom(zoom, anchor = null) {
    const old = this.app.zoom,
      z = nearestZoom(zoom);
    const r = this.viewport.getBoundingClientRect(),
      x = anchor ? anchor.x - r.left : r.width / 2,
      y = anchor ? anchor.y - r.top : r.height / 2,
      px = (this.viewport.scrollLeft + x - 7) / old,
      py = (this.viewport.scrollTop + y - 7) / old;
    this.app.zoom = z;
    this.render();
    this.viewport.scrollLeft = px * z - x + 7;
    this.viewport.scrollTop = py * z - y + 7;
    this.app.prefs.zoom = z;
    this.app.savePrefs();
  }
  fit() {
    const r = this.viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
    this.setZoom(
      fitZoom(Math.min(1, (r.width - 38) / this.doc.width, (r.height - 38) / this.doc.height)),
    );
    this.viewport.scrollLeft = 0;
    this.viewport.scrollTop = 0;
  }
  drawRulers() {
    const zoom=this.app.zoom,ratio=window.devicePixelRatio||1,display=this.display.getBoundingClientRect();
    for(const [id,vertical]of [['ruler-x',false],['ruler-y',true]]) {
      const canvas=document.getElementById(id),length=vertical?this.viewport.clientHeight:this.viewport.clientWidth;
      if(!length)continue;
      const width=vertical?24:length,height=vertical?length:24;
      canvas.style.width=width+'px';canvas.style.height=height+'px';
      canvas.width=Math.round(width*ratio);canvas.height=Math.round(height*ratio);
      const context=canvas.getContext('2d'),bounds=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),origin=vertical?display.top-bounds.top:display.left-bounds.left;
      context.setTransform(ratio,0,0,ratio,0,0);context.fillStyle='#f9fafc';context.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
      context.font='11px Segoe UI, Arial';context.fillStyle='#365b87';context.strokeStyle='#a4b4c9';context.lineWidth=1/ratio;
      const major=zoom<.3?500:zoom<.7?200:zoom<1.5?100:zoom<3?50:20,step=major/10,start=Math.max(0,Math.floor(-origin/zoom/step)*step);
      for(let value=start;value*zoom+origin<length;value+=step) {
        const position=(Math.round((value*zoom+origin)*ratio)+.5)/ratio;
        if(position<0)continue;
        const big=value%major===0,medium=value%(major/2)===0,depth=big?10:medium?6:3;
        context.beginPath();if(vertical){context.moveTo(24-depth,position);context.lineTo(24,position);}else{context.moveTo(position,24-depth);context.lineTo(position,24);}context.stroke();
        if(big){context.save();if(vertical){context.translate(10,position+3);context.rotate(-Math.PI/2);context.fillText(value,0,0);}else context.fillText(value,position+2,12);context.restore();}
      }
    }
  }
}

export const toolIconBody = name => colored[name] || '';
export function icon(name, size = 20) {
  if (colored[name]) return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${colored[name]}</svg>`;
  return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${paths[name] || paths.image}"/></svg>`;
}
